result.summary: Found 3 visual issues on the page: two layout/content truncation problems and one confusing promotional label.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Picco' in the 'Fastest near you' section is truncated, indicating the card width or text handling is insufficient to display the full name.
issues.suggestion: Increase card width, allow the restaurant name to wrap to a second line, or truncate with a clear ellipsis while ensuring the full name is accessible on tap.

issues.description: The second restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section (pizza image) is cut off at the bottom of the screen, hiding the restaurant name, rating, delivery cost, and cuisine information.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or make the list scrollable so the last item is fully visible above the bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: The pizza card displays a '-100%' badge, which is mathematically unusual and likely confusing to users.
issues.suggestion: Clarify the offer text (e.g., '100% off' or 'Free delivery') or correct the badge value if it is a data error.
